subject: Missing invoice VEN041-0022 in GSTR-2B
body:
Dear Titan Logistics Ltd team,

We are reconciling our purchases and note that invoice VEN041-0022 dated 30 Sep 2025 is not shown in your GSTR-2B for Sep 2025 or the following month. Rs 16,278 of input tax credit is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and confirm once it appears. We will hold the credit note until then.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
